responsibility: Declares the hierarchical modref summary tree used to represent memory accesses by base alias set, referenced alias set, and parameter-relative access ranges. It defines modref_access_node, parameter-mapping helpers, templated base/ref/tree containers, insertion and merge operations, collapse behavior, global-access queries, and GGC/PCH interfaces. This header provides the reusable summary format consumed by ipa-modref.cc and alias-analysis clients.
same_name_distinction: Declares the reusable hierarchical modref tree representation—access nodes, base/ref/tree templates, parameter-mapping support, and public insertion/merge/query operations. Unlike gcc/ipa-modref-tree.cc, it does not provide the out-of-line tree algorithms, selftests, or GC marking implementations.
